sources.name: Household net worth statistics
sources.assumptions: Q1-Q4 and the bulk of Q5 are real Stats NZ quintile aggregates (~411,740 households/quintile, ~2.06M households total; band edges between quintiles are interpolated between published medians, not exact Stats NZ cut points). Stats NZ doesn't publish bands above ~$1.5M net worth, which can't resolve a $10M+ wealth-tax threshold - so the top quintile has been split into an ordinary 'rest of Q5' band and a separate ultra-wealthy band, with the ultra-wealthy band's count and average back-calculated to match the Green Party's own 2026 costing (~$3.8bn/year at 2.5% above $10M) rather than sourced independently.

sources.name: IRD High-Wealth Individuals Research Project
sources.assumptions: Directly surveyed 311 wealthy families and found median net worth $106m, mean $276m - consistent with, but not precise enough to replace, the ultra-wealthy band's back-derived $35.4m average above.

sources.name: Green Party 2026 tax policy
sources.assumptions: A 2.5% annual tax on individual net worth above $10M (family home exempt), estimated to raise ~$3.8bn/year - the figure the ultra-wealthy band above is back-calculated against.
